breaking.member: file.shader / file.post / file.ui-material / og ui add materials
breaking.change: Shader, post and UI material author OGT and their parser are removed. Checked TS declarations cook directly into binary WGSL and uniform payloads; runtime loading parses no author text. Material packs install declarations under content/ and WGSL under sources/.
breaking.fix: Export file.shader, file.post or file['ui-material'] from content/*.ts, with code (inline WGSL or input.text of a module-relative sources path) and ordered params [{name,kind,default}]. Load module/content IDs without extensions, for example base/materials/materials/foil. Shader mode is {kind:'hooks'|'sprite'} or {kind:'full',lit:true|false}. Reinstall material presets in the new layout.
